endorsements.label: Defeating Professional Consumer Security System with $110 of equipment
endorsements.description: Our homes provide a place to store our personal belongings and secure them against theft. That’s one of the reasons why we have locks and security devices. Since these are protecting our belongings, and our families, these should be secure from most people being able to break in and act in a criminal manner. Many of the Professional Security Systems are exceptionally vulnerable to very simple attacks. The presentation will show how to render moot these professional security systems using four different sample systems and $110 of equipment easily purchased online. The procedure is so easy, even a caveman can do it. Also, we re-tested an updated system for one manufacture, which was still a failure. The manufacturers have been contacted several times as part of the responsible disclosure protocol.
